puerto-salvador-allende.name: Puerto Salvador Allende
puerto-salvador-allende.price_text: Free to walk the pier · restaurants and boat rides cost extra
puerto-salvador-allende.hours: Promenade open daily roughly 08:00–22:00 · check on the day
puerto-salvador-allende.tip: Come in the late afternoon for lake breezes and sunset over Lake Managua.

national-palace.name: National Palace of Culture, Managua
national-palace.price_text: Small entry fee; ask at the door (check on the day)
national-palace.hours: Weekdays daytime; hours vary, check on the day
national-palace.tip: The building faces the old Plaza de la Revolución; bring photo ID for entry.

masaya-artisan-market.name: Masaya Artisan Market
masaya-artisan-market.price_text: Free to enter · bring cash in córdobas for crafts
masaya-artisan-market.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–18:00 · check on the day
masaya-artisan-market.tip: Haggle politely and carry small bills; it is about 45 minutes by road from Managua.

gallo-pinto.name: Nicaraguan Gallo Pinto
gallo-pinto.price_text: Typical plate ≈ NIO 100–250 depending on the place
gallo-pinto.tip: Try it at a local comedor with fried cheese, plantain and strong coffee.

mercado-roberto-huembes.name: Mercado Roberto Huembes
mercado-roberto-huembes.price_text: Free to enter · food and crafts cost extra
mercado-roberto-huembes.hours: Daily roughly 06:00–18:00 · check on the day
mercado-roberto-huembes.tip: Big local market for crafts, hammocks and cheap eats; keep bags in front of you.

mercado-oriental.name: Mercado Oriental
mercado-oriental.tip: Huge, busy and not touristy; go with a local and leave valuables at the hotel.

old-cathedral.name: Old Cathedral of Managua (ruins)
old-cathedral.hours: Viewable from the plaza at any time
old-cathedral.tip: The earthquake-damaged shell is a photo stop; do not expect to go inside.

loma-de-tiscapa.name: Loma de Tiscapa viewpoint
loma-de-tiscapa.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
loma-de-tiscapa.tip: Best city and lake views; go in clear morning light and skip it after dark.

malecon.name: Malecón lakeside walk
malecon.tip: Walk the waterfront near Puerto Salvador Allende for lake views and street food.

laguna-de-apoyo.name: Laguna de Apoyo day trip
laguna-de-apoyo.price_text: Reserve entry varies; check on the day
laguna-de-apoyo.hours: Daytime; reserves close in the evening
laguna-de-apoyo.tip: Volcanic crater lake about an hour away; bring swimwear and sun protection.

volcan-masaya.name: Masaya Volcano night tour
volcan-masaya.price_text: Tour price varies; check with operator
volcan-masaya.tip: See glowing lava after dark; book a guided tour and follow park rules.

granada-day-trip.name: Granada day trip
granada-day-trip.price_text: Transport and tours vary; check on the day
granada-day-trip.tip: Colonial city about an hour away; pair it with a boat trip on Lake Nicaragua.

bolonia-walk.name: Bolonia neighbourhood walk
bolonia-walk.tip: Leafy streets with cafes and restaurants; good for an evening meal.

ruben-dario-theatre.name: Rubén Darío National Theatre
ruben-dario-theatre.price_text: Ticket price varies by show; check on the day
ruben-dario-theatre.tip: Check the programme for music and dance; the building is a Managua landmark.

huellas-de-acahualinca.name: Huellas de Acahualinca footprints
huellas-de-acahualinca.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
huellas-de-acahualinca.hours: Weekday daytime; check on the day
huellas-de-acahualinca.tip: Ancient human footprints in volcanic mud; a quick, unusual stop.

paseo-xolotlan.name: Paseo Xolotlán
paseo-xolotlan.tip: Lakeside park with small attractions; good for a family stroll.

mercado-huembes-crafts.name: Craft stalls at Roberto Huembes
mercado-huembes-crafts.tip: Good place for hammocks and souvenirs at local prices; bring cash.

cafe-breakfast.name: Local breakfast comedor
cafe-breakfast.tip: Order gallo pinto with eggs and coffee for a cheap, filling start.

city-tour.name: Managua city tour
city-tour.price_text: Tour price varies; check with operator
city-tour.tip: A guided half-day tour helps you understand the city's earthquake history and layout.

monseor-lezcano-walk.name: Monseñor Lezcano neighbourhood walk
monseor-lezcano-walk.tip: Local residential area with markets and simple eateries; go with a local.
